target.statement: RIFT (proposed) ROC AUC = 0.999 on the Blob synthetic dataset (Table 1)
target.dataset: Synthetic 'Blobs' dataset (two perpendicular Gaussian blobs with anomalies around two points, Figure 3)

compute.basis: Synthetic 2D data must be regenerated from the figure description; RIFT-exact needs a full Euclidean MST (O(n^2) edges) plus BFS from every point, trivial for a few thousand 2D points on CPU; no code released so the algorithm must be reimplemented from Algorithm 1.

blockers: No code or data links in the paper; synthetic dataset generation parameters (sample counts, blob centers, anomaly placement) are not specified, so exact AUC 0.999 is not guaranteed to be recovered
Exact MST construction is O(n^2) memory/time, limiting dataset size
title: RIFT: Relative Isolation From Trees For Anomaly Detection
